description: Header file defining the DirectoryLister class for asynchronously listing directory contents, including delegate interface and internal core class with threading and cancellation support.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Provides asynchronous directory listing API with delegate callbacks and thread management.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerData
classes.description: Struct representing a found file's info, path, and absolute path.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving directory entries and completion notification.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Internal reference-counted class managing directory retrieval and sorting on worker thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister
methods.description: Constructs a DirectoryLister with specified directory, optional listing type, and delegate.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Stops directory enumeration asynchronously, preventing delegate callbacks.
